decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of the album 'Country Life'. The provided sources explicitly identify two distinct albums with this title by different artists. Document D1 (sources D1S1-D1S7) describes 'Country Life' as the fourth album by the English rock band 'Roxy Music' (released 1974). Document D2 (sources D2S1-D2S5) and Document D3 (source D3S1) describe 'Country Life' as the eleventh/2003 studio album by the English acoustic roots duo 'Show of Hands'. Since different artists can legitimately release works with an identical title, both 'Roxy Music' and 'Show of Hands' are valid, distinct answers to the query without contradiction.
